description: Recorded fixed-seed opponent matrix for the Supreme coalition and the scripted Normal baseline. Fair Fog (intelligence 0), 0% economic bonus, map shattered-mountain, seeds 805-807, 30000 ticks. Regenerate with ai/selfplay.py --bot-type <ai|normal> --vs rush,normal,turtle,naval --runs 3 --ticks 30000 --seed-base 805 --intelligence 0

known_gaps.note: Correction to an earlier reading. Aircraft ARE produced (heli queued 5x over a 20000-tick four-bot match). The earlier 'air 0' observation came from Coordinated-force gate lines, which stop logging once the gate opens, so they only ever showed the pre-production build-up. The real gap is that no offensive wave launches at all in symmetric self-play, because the enemy base is never located and AdvanceOnInferredBase is off by default - so the combined-arms wave path is never exercised in that configuration.
known_gaps.scouting: ScoutLifetimeBudget defaults to 0, which reuses the concurrent squad size and caps the search at 4 scouts per match. That is why the enemy base is never located. The bound is now a separate, documented parameter rather than a conflation, but raising it measurably costs outcomes until the assault path improves.

scout_budget_sweep.description: ScoutLifetimeBudget controls how many scouts may be dispatched over a whole match while the enemy base is unlocated. 0 reuses ScoutSquadSize (the historical, shipped default).
scout_budget_sweep.conclusion: No setting produces a single win. Reconnaissance that actually works lets the coalition locate the enemy and attack, and attacking converts draws into losses - its offensive execution is a net negative against its own defensive trading. The default stays at 0 so shipped behaviour does not regress.
